Bad staff
Jul 2026 • Family
⭐☆☆☆☆ Absolutely Unacceptable – Worst Customer Service

This was one of the worst experiences I have ever had at a restaurant.

We arrived with three people, and the staff told us they would arrange seating shortly. We waited patiently, but they never made any effort to accommodate us. When our third person arrived, instead of providing the table they had promised, they asked us to go upstairs.

The upstairs area had no proper seating available and was not suitable at all. It was clear that the restaurant was poorly managed and had no concern for its customers. Since they could not provide a proper place to sit, we decided to leave.

The shocking part was that we were never served any food or drinks, the food was not even ready, we didn't use any of their services, yet they still charged us. Charging customers who received absolutely nothing is unfair, unprofessional, and completely unacceptable.

There was no apology, no attempt to solve the problem, and no respect for customers' time or money. A restaurant should know how to manage reservations, seating, and customer service. Unfortunately, House of Martin failed on every level.

I strongly recommend avoiding this place if you expect honest service, professionalism, or basic customer care. There are many better restaurants that actually value their customers.

Vintage whiskey bar with expert mixologists
Feb 2024 • Couples
House of Merlin’s vintage charm makes it perfect for a quiet evening. Their classic cocktails is a must-try, perfectly balancing rum, whiskey, and vodka. The Thai fish cakes were well-spiced and aromatic. The plush sofas and antique lamps add to the warm, nostalgic atmosphere. The staff is knowledgeable and enthusiastic about whiskey. Without live jazz, the ambiance remains inviting and cozy. A great place for whiskey lovers to unwind.
